Information & Support

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Faith Nexus 2027, the Soft Launch, venue, themes, and participation.

When is Faith Nexus 2027?
Faith Nexus 2027 takes place from 14–16 April 2027.
Where is Faith Nexus 2027?
Royal Majestic Hotel, Rosebank, Johannesburg, South Africa.
How many delegates are expected?
Approximately 2,000 delegates are expected to attend in person from across Africa and beyond.
Who should attend?
Faith Nexus is designed for Christian leaders, pastors, creators, media professionals, broadcasters, filmmakers, educators, technology professionals, entrepreneurs, corporate leaders, artists, public-sector leaders, NGOs, students and emerging leaders.
What are the seven strategic pillars?
01 Faith & Spiritual Life, 02 Media & Communication, 03 Technology & Innovation, 04 Governance & Public Life, 05 Education & Discipleship, 06 Economy & Enterprise, and 07 Arts & Culture.
What is Roots. Revelation. Renaissance.?
It is the central theme of Faith Nexus 2027. Roots explores foundations and identity. Revelation explores the changing world around us. Renaissance focuses on what we must build for the future.
What is Covenant Conversations?
Covenant Conversations is a permanent Jewish–Christian education and bridge-building platform within Faith Nexus.
What is CW100 / FN100?
CW100 (FaithNexus100) is a recognition platform celebrating 100 Christian leaders and voices making meaningful contributions across Africa.
Will there be opportunities for creators?
Yes. Faith Nexus will include the Nexus Creators Lounge, Nexus Studio, Creator Masterclasses, Creators Market, Nexus Pitches and Storytellers Showcase.
Can organisations exhibit?
Yes. Faith Nexus will host an Industry Exhibition for organisations serving the faith, media, technology, education, enterprise and creative sectors.
Can organisations sponsor or partner with Faith Nexus?
Yes. A range of sponsorship and strategic partnership opportunities is available across headline, programme, pillar, and venue partnerships.
What is the Faith Nexus Soft Launch?
The Soft Launch is the formal unveiling of Faith Nexus 2027 and takes place on 29 October 2026 in Johannesburg.
Will the Soft Launch be available online?
Yes. The event is planned to be broadcast across multiple virtual platforms worldwide.
When will the full programme be released?
Programme details will be published as sessions and speakers are confirmed. You can register your interest to receive official updates.
How can I stay updated?
Register your interest to receive official Faith Nexus announcements and programme updates directly to your inbox.
